newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan plans to auction 10 billion rupees bonds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan plans to auction 10 billion rupees bonds.

text.p: The State (central) Bank of Pakistan said on Wednesday it had invited tenders by Tuesday for the auction of six-month Short- Term Federal Bonds worth 10 billion rupees.
The tenders will be opened on Tuesday with results to be announced on Wednesday, a bank statement said.
Successful bidders will be required to deposit the amount of accepted bids on Thursday, it said, and added that "Bids can be rejected without assigning any reason."
